Implement concrete phantom-frame DensePull and InversePair types bridged to runtime SpatialDomainId; midpoint advance/result laws; paired exp(+/-v/2) scaling-and-squaring; candidate and accumulated-map Jacobian/inverse guards; and linear-only resolution transfer. Keep the v1 algebra concrete rather than exposing a generic HKT framework.
